tasks.short: Select a pressing machine for the actual garment properties.

steps.what: Read the actual garment care label, material specification and pressing requirement
outputs: verified garment properties and pressing requirement

steps.what: Inspect the garment construction, trims, condition and uncertain heat tolerance
inputs: verified garment properties and pressing requirement
outputs: actual garment constraints and unresolved material questions

steps.what: Look up the approved pressing-machine capabilities and material limits for the garment
inputs: actual garment constraints and unresolved material questions

steps.what: Select appropriate pressing machines based on garment properties such as heat tolerance and resolve uncertain suitability with the supervisor
inputs: actual garment constraints and unresolved material questions
outputs: human machine selection or held garment

tasks.design: Configure a simple material-and-machine reference index in {DOCS} using controlled instructions. It helps find limits; the presser still reads the actual garment, inspects its construction and chooses or holds it without automatic machine control.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable instruction can require paging through several references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document indexing can expose the right existing instruction without inventing a pressing setting.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain fibers, trims, previous damage and misleading labels.
tasks.human_edge: Recognizing when a garment needs cautious handling or specialist advice.

ambition.what: No additional garments or faster pressing cycle is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less reference searching, unchanged machine-selection responsibility.

reach.task: Identify a garment requiring special handling
reach.learn: Read care symbols and escalate material uncertainty.

evidence.claim: A controlled document index can reduce instruction retrieval without identifying garment properties or selecting settings automatically.

assumptions: Boundary ends at selecting the machine. Installation, settings changes, actual pressing and completed-work records are separate tasks; no baseline time or saving is assigned to them.

Manufacturers and authorized supervisors produce machine ID, revision, compatible material, applicable limits and instruction link. The presser supplies actual care-label and garment observations. Missing labels or uncertain fibers require manual resolution; no image model guesses heat tolerance.

Test native {DOCS} indexing first. This scenario applies only when reference lookup actually recurs; routine selections made from already available guidance receive no saving. No new record, report or send is added.
unknowns: How often instruction retrieval is needed and whether the current index is already sufficient.
research_questions: Can a native index remove retrieval time without encouraging unsupported material assumptions?

already_counted.description: Physical label reading, garment inspection and final machine selection remain fully counted.

incremental.description: Keep controlled machine and material reference links current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: For selections with real reference lookup, that 20-point step falls to 70%, saving 6 less 0.5 upkeep. Low is no deployment when lookup is already immediate or does not occur.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select, install and adjust pressing-machine components.

steps.what: Select the required pressing forms, rollers or guides against the actual job and machine specification
Inspect the actual components and prepare the existing safe isolation, hoist and hand-tool arrangement
outputs: checked components and safe work setup

steps.what: Install the actual machine components using the appropriate hoists and hand tools under the existing work procedure
inputs: checked components and safe work setup

steps.what: Adjust the installed pressing forms, rollers or guides to the specified physical alignment
Check the actual installation, fastening, clearances and adjustment against the existing setup procedure
outputs: verified physical component setup or unresolved defect

tasks.design: Keep component selection, inspection, hoist and hand-tool installation, adjustment and physical verification manual. Review native machine instructions before proposing software; no changed mechanical or administrative step supports a saving within this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The components must be physically handled, fitted and checked.
tasks.enabler_now: Available instructions can support the existing procedure but do not replace the work.
tasks.still_hard: Correct fit, safe handling and alignment on the actual machine.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing wear, poor fit and physical setup problems directly.

ambition.what: No faster installation or automatic machine adjustment is claimed.

tasks.altitude: No change in work or decision rights.

reach.task: Communicate an observed component fit or wear problem
reach.learn: Describe the physical symptom and stay within the existing maintenance scope.

evidence.claim: Physical installation and adjustment with hoists and hand tools are not shortened by a document or model workflow alone.

assumptions: Boundary is actual component setup. A check for record writing, reports and sends found none required by this task statement or this mechanical workflow; a separate production setup log, if required locally, must be measured and allocated once rather than invented as saving here.

The authorized setup instruction supplies machine ID, component specification, fit and adjustment requirements. The presser reads the existing job card and actual component markings; missing or conflicting requirements are resolved manually.

Native machine instructions were considered; no recurring search or re-entry reduction is established for this setup task. No new software, automated setting write or upkeep is introduced, so incremental hours are zero.
The two physical modification steps remain manual under existing machine-safety controls. No automatic machine command, record commit or external send is part of the design.
unknowns: Whether a separate setup record is required and where its actual capture time is owned.
research_questions: Does the site have a distinct repeated setup-record entry worth assessing separately from mechanical installation?

already_counted.description: Actual component inspection and physical installation verification remain counted.

incremental.description: No new software or routine introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All five physical setup steps remain unchanged. No record-writing, report or send baseline has been added to obtain a saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The presser retains hands-on machine and garment judgement. A native reference index may remove a small amount of lookup time where that work actually occurs.
reach: Describe component wear and garment-handling uncertainties clearly to maintenance or laundry colleagues.
skills_to_grow: Separate physical work from any distinct setup record
role.ambitious_version: Use better access to verified instructions to resolve unusual garment questions carefully, without promising faster pressing or installation.

job.title: Pressers, Textile, Garment, and Related Materials
